unit.label: Schools, scenery & locations
unit.title: Around the School
unit.description: 12 new words and forms. Describe a school and its surroundings, find places, and say where you study.

goal.text: 我現在在圖書館裡面看書。
goal.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài zài túshūguǎn lǐmiàn kàn shū.
goal.meaning: I am reading inside the library now.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 6, pp. 104–112, 114–115; 在 + place + action in Dialogue II, pp. 107–109.

lessons.title: At School Now
lessons.subtitle: Name the place and say where you are now.

steps.prompt: Why are there two written 在 in 現在在學校?
options: 現在 means now; the next 在 introduces the place.
steps.answer: 現在 means now; the next 在 introduces the place.
steps.explanation: Keep the word 現在 together, then add 在 + 學校.

steps.prompt: Which statement says “I am at school now”?
steps.explanation: 現在 says now, and 在學校 says at school.
現 is xiàn, the first syllable of 現在.

lessons.title: Mountains and the Sea
lessons.subtitle: Use 山上 as a complete location.

steps.prompt: Does 在山上 necessarily mean at the exact mountain summit?
options: No; it can mean on the mountain or in the mountains.
Yes; it always means the summit.
No; it means in the sea.
steps.answer: No; it can mean on the mountain or in the mountains.
steps.explanation: 山上 describes the mountain location without requiring the highest point.

steps.prompt: Which completes 學校在 __ for “The school is in the mountains”?
steps.explanation: 山上 is the location expression taught here.
海 is hǎi, third tone: sea or ocean.

lessons.title: Beautiful Scenery
lessons.subtitle: Describe the view and share what you have heard.

steps.prompt: Which word names the scenery itself?
steps.explanation: 風景 is the noun scenery; 美 is the description beautiful.
Use 很 before 美. Do not add 是 to this ordinary adjective predicate.

steps.prompt: Review: what does 聽說 contribute to 我聽說那裡的風景很美?
options: This is something I have heard.
I know how to draw it.
steps.answer: This is something I have heard.
steps.explanation: 聽說 gives the source as a report heard from others.
景 is jǐng, the third-tone second syllable of 風景.

lessons.title: Inside or Outside?
lessons.subtitle: Put the reference place before its inside or outside.

steps.prompt: For “inside the school,” which order places the school as the reference point?
steps.explanation: The reference place comes first, followed by 裡面.
外面 uses 面. 麵 is noodles, even though both characters sound miàn.

steps.prompt: In 地方, which pronunciation is used here?
steps.explanation: In this noun, 地 is dì and 方 is fāng.

lessons.title: There Is a Library
lessons.subtitle: Distinguish naming a location from saying what is there.

steps.prompt: Someone asks “Where is the library?” Choose the direct location answer.
steps.explanation: Name the known thing first, then 在 + its location.

steps.prompt: Choose the sentence saying there is no restaurant inside the library.
options: 圖書館沒有在餐廳裡面。
steps.explanation: Negate existential 有 with 沒有.
館 is guǎn, the final syllable of 圖書館.

lessons.title: Where You Study
lessons.subtitle: Put the place before the action.

steps.prompt: Which sentence follows time → place → action?
steps.explanation: 現在 is time, 在圖書館 is location, and 看書 is the action.

steps.prompt: Which sentence explicitly includes going to school?
steps.explanation: 去 expresses the movement; 在 specifies a location.

steps.prompt: In 我在學校上課, what does 在 introduce?
steps.explanation: 在 is followed by the place 學校, then the action 上課.
課 is kè, the falling-tone final syllable in 上課.

lessons.title: Unit 18 Review
lessons.subtitle: Locate places, describe the view, and say where you study.

steps.prompt: Read: 學校外面有一家餐廳。 Where is the restaurant?
steps.explanation: 學校外面 sets the location, and 有 introduces the restaurant there.

steps.prompt: Read: 我現在不在圖書館裡面，我在外面。 Where am I now?
steps.explanation: The second statement supplies the location: 在外面.

steps.prompt: Which asks whether there is a library at the school?
options: 學校裡面有沒有圖書館？
steps.answer: 學校裡面有沒有圖書館？
steps.explanation: 有沒有 asks about the existence of a library at that location.
風景 is scenery. 現在 is now; 地方 is place.
海 is hǎi: sea or ocean.

newVocabulary.meaning: on a mountain; in the mountains
to attend class; to have class

校.note: 學校 (xuéxiào) means school. 學 was already taught; 校 is the new second character.
校.memory: A wood-shaped block on the left stands beside crossed lower strokes on the right.

parts.label: 木
parts.name: wood-shaped left
parts.description: The left 木 has four strokes; its final stroke is shortened to fit the right-hand block.

parts.label: 交
parts.name: right-hand block
parts.description: The six strokes of 交 begin with a dot and horizontal, then spread into crossed lower strokes.

現.note: 現在 (xiànzài) means now. The familiar 在 is the second character; 現 is new.
現.memory: A narrow king-shaped block stands beside an eye with two legs.

parts.label: 王
parts.name: jade-side shape
parts.description: This four-stroke side form is written like a narrow 王; the lower stroke rises slightly.

parts.label: 見
parts.name: see-shaped right
parts.description: 見 has an eye-shaped upper frame and two spreading strokes below it, seven strokes total.

山.note: 山 names a mountain. In 山上 it combines with the familiar 上 to make a location: on a mountain or in the mountains.
山.memory: Think of three peaks joined along the base. Start with the middle peak.

parts.label: 丨
parts.name: middle upright
parts.description: The first stroke is the tall central upright.

parts.label: 凵
parts.name: outer sides and base
parts.description: The second stroke bends from the left side along the base; the third forms the right side.

海.note: 海 means sea or ocean. Its water-side component helps distinguish it from other new scenery characters.
海.memory: Three water marks sit to the left of a compact, divided block.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: water side
parts.description: The three water strokes descend along the left, with the last one rising.

parts.label: 每
parts.name: right-hand block
parts.description: The seven-stroke 每 begins with a short slant and horizontal above the divided lower enclosure.

風.meaning: wind; first syllable of 風景
風.note: 風 is the first syllable of 風景, scenery. Use the full word 風景 for scenery, rather than 風 by itself.
風.memory: A tall curved frame shelters a compact insect-like shape.

parts.label: 𠘨
parts.name: outer frame
parts.description: The first two strokes form the left side and the broad hooked outer frame.

parts.label: 䖝
parts.name: inner strokes
parts.description: A short top slant and the insect-shaped lower section fill the frame; the final small dot stays inside.

景.note: 景 completes 風景. The top 日 is separate from the larger 京-shaped block below.
景.memory: Picture a small sun above a tall lower block with a box and three spreading strokes.

parts.label: 日
parts.name: sun-shaped top
parts.description: Four strokes make the upper box with its interior horizontal line.

parts.label: 京
parts.name: lower block
parts.description: The eight-stroke 京 begins with a dot and horizontal, then a box, then the three strokes of 小.

美.note: 美 describes beauty, especially in scenery here. Say 風景很美, the scenery is beautiful.
美.memory: A six-stroke upper group balances on the three spreading strokes of 大.

parts.label: 𦍌
parts.name: upper group
parts.description: The upper six strokes include the two short top strokes, three horizontals and a central upright.

parts.label: 大
parts.name: large-shaped bottom
parts.description: Three lower strokes form 大; keep the final two strokes wide and balanced.

地.note: 地 is dì in 地方, place. Learn the sound in this word; 地 can have a different grammatical reading in later material.
地.memory: The earth-shaped left stands beside the familiar shape 也.

parts.label: 土
parts.name: earth side
parts.description: Three strokes form a narrow 土 on the left; its final line rises slightly.

parts.label: 也
parts.name: right-hand shape
parts.description: The three-stroke 也 stretches to the right with its final bent hook.

方.note: 方 is fāng in 地方. Read 地方 as dìfāng here, with first tone on 方.
方.memory: Keep the top dot separate, then place a bending stroke and a long slant below the horizontal.

parts.label: 丶
parts.name: top dot
parts.description: The first stroke is a small dot above the main horizontal.

parts.label: 万
parts.name: lower outline
parts.description: The next strokes are the horizontal, the turning hooked stroke, and the final left-falling stroke.

面.meaning: side; miàn in 裡面 and 外面
面.note: 面 appears in 裡面 and 外面. It sounds like 麵, noodles, but is a different character; do not add the wheat-side strokes of 麵.
面.memory: A top line and short slant lead down into a framed, divided face.

parts.label: 丆
parts.name: top strokes
parts.description: Begin with the horizontal and the short left-falling stroke beneath it.

parts.label: 囬
parts.name: framed lower block
parts.description: The lower seven strokes form the outer frame and its internal divisions. Close the outer bottom last.

圖.note: 圖 starts 圖書館, library. In this Traditional form the outer frame encloses a detailed inner block.
圖.memory: Build the large frame around the small inner forms; save its bottom line for last.

parts.label: 囗
parts.name: outer enclosure
parts.description: Begin the frame with two strokes, write the eleven inner strokes, then close the bottom with the last stroke.

parts.label: 啚
parts.name: inner block
parts.description: Eleven inner strokes make a small top box and a larger divided structure beneath it.

館.note: 館 completes 圖書館. 書 in the middle is already familiar, so 圖 and 館 are the new writing targets.
館.memory: A food-shaped side stands next to a roof sheltering stacked shapes.

parts.label: 飠
parts.name: food side
parts.description: Eight strokes form the narrow Traditional food component on the left.

parts.label: 官
parts.name: right-hand block
parts.description: The eight-stroke 官 starts with a roof and ends with a vertically arranged inner block.

課.note: 課 is the class character in 上課, to attend class. It is different from 書, a book.
課.memory: Speech on the left sits beside a fruit-shaped block with a tree-like base.

parts.label: 言
parts.name: speech side
parts.description: The seven-stroke 言 begins with a dot and horizontal lines, with a small mouth box below.

parts.label: 果
parts.name: fruit-shaped right
parts.description: The eight-stroke 果 has a divided upper box and a long central stroke that continues into the spreading lower strokes.

u18-school.title: Locate someone at a school
u18-school.explanation: 學校 (xuéxiào) is school. You already know 在 for where someone or something is. Replace 這裡 with 學校 to say at school. 我們學校 means our school; 我們的學校 is also possible.

examples.meaning: I am at school.
Where is your school?

u18-school.remember: 在 + 學校 gives a location; 去 + 學校 says go to school.

u18-now.title: Put now before the location statement
u18-now.explanation: 現在 (xiànzài) means now. Put this time word before the location statement, just as 今天 or 昨天 comes before the predicate. In 現在在學校, the first 在 belongs inside the word 現在; the second 在 means be at. Both are needed.

examples.meaning: I am at school now.
Where are you now?

u18-now.remember: 現在 = now. 在 = be at. The two characters 在 in 現在在 have different jobs.

u18-mountain.title: Turn a mountain into a location
u18-mountain.explanation: 山 (shān) means mountain. 山上 (shānshàng) means on a mountain or in the mountains; it does not have to mean the very summit. Here the familiar 上 has the concrete location meaning on or up, different from its use inside 上網.

examples.meaning: That restaurant is in the mountains.
Our school is on a mountain.

u18-mountain.remember: For this meaning, use 在山上 rather than 在山.

u18-sea.title: Name the sea
u18-sea.explanation: 海 (hǎi) means sea or ocean. Use 看海 for looking at the sea. 和 can join 山 and 海 as nouns, just as it joined other nouns earlier.

examples.meaning: I want to go look at the sea.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān shān, yě xǐhuān hǎi.
examples.meaning: I like mountains, and I like the sea too.

u18-sea.remember: 海 names the sea. 山上 names a location in the mountains.

u18-scenery.title: A noun for scenery and a description for beauty
u18-scenery.explanation: 風景 (fēngjǐng) means scenery. 美 (měi) means beautiful. Put 很 before 美 in a simple description, as with 很好看. 這裡的風景 is the scenery here: 的 connects the location to the scenery being discussed.

examples.meaning: The scenery here is beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Shān hé hǎi dōu hěn měi.
examples.meaning: The mountains and the sea are both beautiful.

u18-scenery.remember: 風景 names what you see; 美 describes its beauty.

u18-place.title: Refer to a place as a thing
u18-place.pattern: 這 / 那 + 個 + 地方
u18-place.explanation: 地方 (dìfāng) means place. Use the familiar measure word 個: 這個地方, this place. Read both syllables as dìfāng. 地方 can name the place you are discussing without naming a particular building.

examples.meaning: This place is beautiful.
Which place do you like?

u18-place.remember: 這個地方 = this place; 那個地方 = that place.

u18-inside-outside.title: Make the position specific
u18-inside-outside.pattern: reference place + (的) + 裡面 / 外面
u18-inside-outside.explanation: 裡面 (lǐmiàn) is inside and 外面 (wàimiàn) is outside. Put the reference place first: 學校裡面 means inside the school. 的 can be included: 學校的裡面. When the reference place is understood, 裡面 or 外面 can stand alone. The suffix is 面, not 麵, noodles.

examples.meaning: I am inside the school.
I am outside the school.
He is outside.

u18-inside-outside.remember: Name the reference place before 裡面 or 外面.

u18-not-at.title: Negate a location with 不在
u18-not-at.pattern: person / place + 不 + 在 + location
u18-not-at.explanation: For a location statement, put 不 before 在. 學生不在裡面 means the students are not inside. This does not tell you where they are, so add a second statement if you want to specify that.

examples.text: 老師不在學校裡面，在外面。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bú zài xuéxiào lǐmiàn, zài wàimiàn.
examples.meaning: The teacher is not inside the school; the teacher is outside.

u18-not-at.remember: 不在 negates be at; 沒有 is used for have not or there is not.

u18-library.title: Name a place for books
u18-library.pattern: 圖 + 書 + 館 → 圖書館
u18-library.explanation: 圖書館 (túshūguǎn) means library. Keep its three syllables together. 書, book, is already familiar. You can say 在圖書館 for at or in the library; add 裡面 to make inside explicit. Use 外面 when you specifically mean outside.

examples.meaning: The teacher is at the library.
The teacher is outside the library.

u18-library.remember: 圖書館 is the place name; 圖書館外面 is outside that place.

u18-there-is.title: Start with a place, then say what is there
u18-there-is.explanation: You already know 我有… for I have…. With a place first, 有 says what exists there: 學校裡面有圖書館 means there is a library inside the school. This introduces a library as something present there. To say where a particular library is, reverse the focus: 圖書館在學校裡面.

examples.meaning: There is a library inside the school.
The library is inside the school.
There is a restaurant in the mountains.

u18-there-is.remember: Location + 有 tells what is there. Thing + 在 tells where it is.

u18-there-is-question.title: Ask whether something is there
u18-there-is-question.pattern: place + 有沒有 + noun？; place + 沒有 + noun
u18-there-is-question.explanation: Use 有沒有 to ask whether a place has something. To say there is none, use 沒有, not 不有. No measure word is needed just to ask whether a library exists.

examples.text: 學校裡面有沒有圖書館？
examples.meaning: Is there a library inside the school?
There is no restaurant inside the library.

u18-there-is-question.remember: 有沒有 asks about existence. 沒有 says there is none.

u18-class.title: Attend class
u18-class.explanation: 上課 (shàngkè) means attend or have class. Here 上 belongs to the activity 上課; it does not mean physically on top of a class. 學中文 describes what you study; 上課 says you attend class.

examples.meaning: We have class today.
I want to go to school to attend class.

u18-class.remember: Keep the activity 上課 together.

u18-location-action.title: Say where an activity happens
u18-location-action.explanation: To tell where you do something, put 在 + place before the action. 我在學校上課 means I attend class at school. Add 現在 before 在 for now. In these sentences 在 introduces a place; it is not the separate progressive use of 在 directly before a verb.

examples.meaning: I attend class at school.

examples.text: 我現在在圖書館裡面看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài zài túshūguǎn lǐmiàn kàn shū.
examples.meaning: I am reading inside the library now.
Where do you study Chinese?

u18-location-action.remember: Time → 在 + place → action. Ask with 在哪裡 before the action.

u18-go-or-at.title: Going somewhere and doing something there
u18-go-or-at.pattern: 去 + place + action; 在 + place + action
u18-go-or-at.explanation: 去學校上課 means go to school to attend class: movement followed by its purpose. 在學校上課 says where class happens and does not itself describe going there. Choose based on what you want to communicate.

examples.meaning: I go to school to attend class.
I attend class at school.

u18-go-or-at.remember: 去 introduces going to a place. 在 introduces the place where an action happens.

u18-mountain-school.meaning: Their school is in the mountains.

u18-sea-plan.text: 明天我們一起去看海吧。
u18-sea-plan.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn hǎi ba.
u18-sea-plan.meaning: Let us go look at the sea together tomorrow.

u18-beautiful-view.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de fēngjǐng hěn měi.
u18-beautiful-view.meaning: The scenery at our school is beautiful.

u18-heard-view.text: 我聽說那裡的風景很美。
u18-heard-view.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō nàlǐ de fēngjǐng hěn měi.
u18-heard-view.meaning: I have heard that the scenery there is beautiful.

u18-inside-school.meaning: The students are inside the school.

u18-outside-restaurant.text: 我不在餐廳裡面，我在外面。
u18-outside-restaurant.pinyin: Wǒ bú zài cāntīng lǐmiàn, wǒ zài wàimiàn.
u18-outside-restaurant.meaning: I am not inside the restaurant; I am outside.

u18-there-library.meaning: There is a library inside the school.

u18-library-location.meaning: The library is inside the school.

u18-any-restaurants.meaning: Are there any restaurants outside the school?

u18-study-now.text: 我現在在圖書館裡面看書。
u18-study-now.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài zài túshūguǎn lǐmiàn kàn shū.
u18-study-now.meaning: I am reading inside the library now.

u18-at-class.meaning: We have class at school today.
